notes: Categories as NSE publishes them; 'Retail' includes HUF, individuals / proprietorships, NRI and partnerships / LLPs; 'Others' includes corporates, trusts, DFIs other than banks and insurers, NPS, NBFCs and PRO trades. FPI figures come from NSDL and trail by a day or two (NSE's notes).
`monthly` is the file's 'Historical' sheet: DII turnover by sub-category, by month.
notes_published: 1. Data is categorised first on custodial participant code basis and if custodial participant code is not assigned, then as per client category codes as uploaded by trading members in UCC system.
2. ‘Retail’ includes HUF, Individual/Proprietorship Firms, NRI and Partnership Firm / Limited Liability Partnership.

3. ‘Others’ includes FPI, Public & Private Companies/Bodies Corporates, Trust / Society, Domestic Financial Institutions (Other than Banks & Insurance), Statutory Bodies, New Pension System (NPS), Non-Govt. Organisation, Depository Receipts, Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), Domestic Venture Capital Fund and PRO trades.

4. FPI data has been sourced from NSDL. The data in respect of confirmed FII/FPI trades is compiled on the basis of reports submitted to depositories by Custodians constitutes trades conducted by FIIs/FPIs on and up to the previous trading day(s).
